response.justification: Bogdan brings 20 years of solid software engineering experience and strong cloud/infrastructure expertise. However, this Principal Engineer role specifically requires recognized AI expertise and demonstrated strategic impact. His AI work is recent (since April 2025 at re:cinq with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP), which while promising, is insufficient to establish the deep AI credentials needed for a director-level AI strategy position. He lacks the advanced AI degree, published work, or demonstrated AI products that would support advising customers and defining strategic AI initiatives at this level.
strengths: 20 years of proven software engineering expertise across web, mobile, embedded systems; demonstrates technical depth and adaptability across diverse technologies
Strong cloud and infrastructure engineering background with hands-on expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, microservices, and high-performance systems
Established track record of technical leadership and knowledge sharing through senior roles, mentorship, and active open-source contributions (GISCollective, Trial)
concerns: No advanced degree or demonstrated machine learning expertise before April 2025; lacks foundational AI background expected for this specialized role
AI infrastructure experience is too recent (~1.3 years) to establish recognized expertise for advising customers on cutting-edge AI adoption
Career history emphasizes individual technical contribution rather than director-level strategic leadership; limited evidence of enterprise-scale strategic initiatives

key_factors.factor: Lack of recognized AI/ML expertise and track record
Strong software engineering and cloud foundations
Recent but insufficient AI infrastructure experience
